title: Entropy increases from solid to gas
caption: Entropy measures the number of ways particles and their energy can be arranged. A solid's particles are fixed in place (low entropy); a liquid's can move past each other; a gas's are free to be almost anywhere (high entropy). S(H₂O): ice 41, water 70, steam 189 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
alt: Three boxes of water molecules: ordered solid, disordered liquid and widely scattered gas.
description: Ice: ordered, S about 41 J K⁻¹ mol⁻¹.
